newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-COTTON CALLS FOR EXPULSION OF CLUBS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-COTTON CALLS FOR EXPULSION OF CLUBS.

text.p: Former England captain Fran Cotton, who will manage the British Lions in South Africa next year, has urged the Rugby Football Union (RFU) to expel its leading clubs.
Clubs from the top two leagues have threatened to ban their players from appearing in divisional fixtures, which were intended as trials for international selection.
"According to their spokesmen, these clubs have no wish to be part of the RFU and appear to me to be in breach of RFU bye-laws," Cotton said on Wednesday.
"I can't see why they should not be expelled so that the rest of the game can get on with running its affairs in a sensible and affordable way."
The union has been embroiled in an eight-month row with the EPRUC, which represents the leading clubs.
